scheme_name: Pledge Financing Scheme Against Negotiable Warehouse Receipts (e-NWR)
statutory_clause: Section 4(A): Pledge Financing against Electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipts (e-NWR) to Small and Marginal Farmers
summary: Eligible small and marginal farmers can pledge e-NWR issued by WDRA-accredited warehouses to obtain immediate liquidity up to 75% LTV of current modal market valuation at 7% base interest with 3% prompt repayment subvention (effective 4% p.a.) for up to 6 months under the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) post-harvest framework.

scheme_name: WDRA Scientific Warehousing & e-NWR Electronic Pledge Framework
statutory_clause: Rule 14 & Rule 27: Electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipt (e-NWR) Security, Fiduciary Guarantee and Assaying Standards
summary: Mandates that WDRA-accredited scientific cold storages and warehouses guarantee fiduciary protection against weight loss, spoilage, and quality deterioration. Pledged stock generates legally binding electronic e-NWRs on NeRL/CCRL repository platforms recognized by commercial and cooperative banks.

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) Post-Harvest Management Scheme
issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI / NABARD
statutory_clause: Operational Guidelines Clause 3.2: 3% Interest Subvention & Credit Guarantee for Farm-Gate Post-Harvest Infrastructure
summary: Provides 3% annual interest subvention for medium-to-long term debt financing up to ₹2 Crore for investment in viable post-harvest management projects, cold stores, cold chain logistics, and primary processing units with CGTMSE credit guarantee coverage.

scheme_name: KCC Post-Harvest Produce Marketing / Warehouse Receipt Loan
statutory_clause: Clause 2.1(b): Post-Harvest Liquidity Window against Warehouse Receipts for Individual Farmers
summary: Provides post-harvest distress mitigation loans up to ₹3,00,000 for a period of up to 6 months against pledged warehouse receipts/e-NWR at 7% base interest with 3% prompt repayment subvention (net 4% p.a.) to avert panic sales during harvest market gluts.
